newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA GROUP PROFIT DOWN IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: HANSA GROUP PROFIT DOWN IN APRIL.

text.p: Hansapank Group had a net profit of 35.3 million kroons in April compared to 41.6 million kroons in March, it said on Tuesday.
Hansabank group's total assets grew by 570.4 million kroons or 6.6 percent in April, amounting to 9.2 billion kroons, it added in a statement.
The group's deposits grew by 321.4 million kroons or 6.7 percent, totalling 5.1 billion kroons. Time deposits increased by 11.4 percent or 126.5 million kroons.
Total shareholders' equity increased by 1.3 percent during the month, due to dividends paid in April.
In April the group's net income was 35.3 million kroons with Hansapank contributing 26.1 million kroons and Hansa leasing adding 4.7 million kroons.
The loan portfolio increased by 332.6 million kroons to total 4.4 billion kroons at the end of April, the group said.
During April significant growth was experienced by trading account assets, which increased by 126.8 million kroons or by 102.6 million kroons.
The group also said that it has increased its market share in the Baltic countries to 12 percent.
